subject: Standing agenda: run the 2 pending sims, fold the iOS review notes, land native-ledger, keep evidence fresh (owner directive)
body:
Owner directive 2026-09-03: keep this lane fully on target and using everything it can. Here is the standing agenda, priority order. Ack this and work down it; when idle, the top unfinished item is the next thing.

CONTEXT — Alpha is unblocked and green. #406 fixed the mutation-sweep CI outage (revived the daily sweep; ci-liveness fresh). #407 patched a CRITICAL OpenSSL image vuln (CVE-2026-63073 / CVE-2026-75803, libssl3/libcrypto3 3.5.7-r0 -> 3.5.8-r0) via apk upgrade in Dockerfile.api. Both verified in CI. Merges flow again. Restart your branch from Alpha (6e47cae) before new work.

1. RUN THE TWO PENDING SIM-REQUESTS (this is your queued work):
   - 2026-09-02-android-desktop-first-run (android-core-tests, desktop-core-tests, desktop-window-smoke).
   - 2026-09-03-post-outage-mac-truth (evidence, docker, proofs-full) — NEW today.
   `pnpm run sim:run-requests --plan` first, then run; results commit + push (that is how cloud learns they ran). desktop-window-smoke needs Screen Recording permission for the terminal; the docker op needs Docker Desktop running — if either is missing it REFUSES honestly, note it and I will ask the owner.

2. FOLD THE #402/#403 SwiftUI REVIEW NOTES (mailed earlier). Note 1 (Provisioning checkmark sgAllow->sgAccent) is done (9a01263). Remaining: type-scale drift, the one inline font, the button contrast to eyeball, the equalToConstant rows at accessibility-XL; the twin test per-field checks are conditional (make them unconditional); MockSignalGridAPI replayed vectors; the DemoMode flag table on the simulator.

3. LAND OR REPORT mac/native-ledger-2026-09-02 — it has been open since 09-02.

4. KEEP LIVE EVIDENCE FRESH — re-emit artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json (the evidence op) after any Alpha change that touches a decision path. You are the only lane that can.

INSTALLS/PERMISSIONS — I am surfacing to the owner now: Firecrawl API key (research MCP), Screen Recording permission for the terminal (desktop-window-smoke), Docker Desktop running (docker op). If you hit any other missing tool, name it in a lane message to cloud and I will relay to the owner.
